headline.text: L3 ML4 depositor issues caused *3 hours down* through the night, compounded by white-cream quality miss

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 4 scraped undersized caramel and restarted from combing after dimensional failures. Sollich 2 ran out of flow wrap 8 pallets short of order. Sollich 1 started production mid-morning after software fix for recurring pump coupling failures and cleaning rework.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 ran smoothly with routine mold jams. FFS web tracking caused multiple stops and heavy scrap; white line adjustments continued through first shift.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 lost 3 hours overnight to depositor slider and water-filter issues, then discovered molds with missing white cream went to cooling cabinet. Truffle ran clean. ML1 had brief scale and chiller issues, both cleared.

notes.text: Software interlock added to Sollich 1 buffer pump to prevent Lovejoy coupling failures when valve closed.
Tapioca ingredient (10267) delivery moved up to Thursday 10am per scheduling team.
Whole milk automatic filling pipe to Mixing Tank B clogged; continuing manual add until maintenance inspects.
Cones placed around ML4 chiller fans after second night of accidental unplugging.

resolved.title: S1 buffer tank pump Lovejoy coupling broke (recurring)
resolved.summary: Pump faulted when sending chocolate to buffer, Lovejoy coupling broken; replacement broke immediately, indicating programming or alignment issue.
resolved.resolution: Sollich updated software at 07:27 to interlock Sweco tank pump to valve — pump won't turn on if valve not open (Matt Hatch).

resolved.title: S3 metal detector belt stuck open, product falling into reject bin
resolved.summary: MD belt remained open during operation, all product falling into MD bin instead of passing through.
resolved.resolution: Production and maintenance removed buildup from MD rollers at 10:35, tested with cards, opening and closing correctly (Mariela Gudino).

resolved.title: S4 caramel depositors D1 & D2 failed ATP after caustic wash
resolved.summary: First caustic wash left depositors very dirty, required two additional caustic cycles before QA passed for production.
resolved.resolution: QA passed D1 & D2 after third caustic wash at 13:13, ready to start cooking (S4 Kitchen Tablet).

resolved.title: S1 blue Z-conveyors dirty with S'mores cereal residue
resolved.summary: Conveyors wrapped in plastic after previous cleaning but had significant residue from S'mores, needed re-clean before use.
resolved.resolution: Supervisor instructed to clean again and remove residue. Alfonsina noted it will take longer (16:57).

resolved.title: S1 metal detector belt and roller had chocolate residue
resolved.summary: Dirty roller and belt section with chocolate found during pre-op inspection.
resolved.resolution: Team leader informed to have it cleaned again (Alfonsina Gil 16:55).

resolved.title: S2 chocolate 10121 ran out on building
resolved.summary: No chocolate 10121 inventory in building, melting tanks at 76% and 68%, MRC request submitted.
resolved.resolution: Chocolate arrived from Springville at 05:26 (Ricardo Tovar).

resolved.title: S1 blue belt tension rollers in wrong position
resolved.summary: Belt running without tension rollers in correct spot, noticeably skipping.
resolved.resolution: Victor confirmed will speak to leader to ensure correct belt tension (09:42).

resolved.title: S3 capper back rail loose, jars not held tightly
resolved.summary: Capper not holding jars tightly enough when entering capping station, back rail became loose.
resolved.resolution: Tightened back rail, tested 30 jars, looks good, running at 11:24 (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S1 chiller breaker tripped
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 11:16 when chiller breaker tripped.
resolved.resolution: Matt Hatch reset breaker, everything working again, two good tempers, line running at 11:40 (S1 Enrober).

resolved.title: FFS web tracking fault on white line
resolved.summary: Line down at 23:09 due to web tracking issue, caused large scrap from reworking pouches and film tubes.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance made adjustments, line running at 00:19 (VFFS). Scrap explained by Zack Kurtz 01:27.

resolved.title: ML2 soft caramel texture in center
resolved.summary: Caramel coming through with soft texture in center, team working to improve.
resolved.resolution: Fixed (Dakota Adair 15:21), Victor confirmed better at 15:27.

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 3 slider A failure and water leak
resolved.summary: Slider A faulted at 03:16, water filter found leaking into pan under depositor, o-ring replaced, tested and running by 06:10.
resolved.resolution: Leak fixed at 05:37 (Kavin Ayala), depositor tested at 06:07, line back up at 06:10 (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML1 glycol level low
resolved.summary: Glycol level dropping in system, maintenance requested at 14:22.
resolved.resolution: Nathan Ruiz refilled, reported "nice and full again" at 14:50.

resolved.title: ML1 checkweigher tare incorrect causing product accumulation
resolved.summary: Scale tare wrong, product accumulating, line stopped at 18:31 for maintenance to correct.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance changed tare, line running at 18:33 (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

resolved.title: ML1 temper spiked to 0.8
resolved.summary: Raoul stopped depositing at 01:15 to make adjustments when temper read 0.8.
resolved.resolution: Temper back to 0.7 (yellow) at 01:30, started running back (Raoul Lubain).

resolved.title: ML4 chiller fans unplugged, both compressors faulted
resolved.summary: Someone stepped on cord, unplugged chiller fans, both compressors faulted at 06:17; operators caught before temper readings affected.
resolved.resolution: Fans reconnected, operators caught on time before temper readings impacted (ML4 TG 06:27). Cones placed to prevent recurrence (Itzel 07:24).

needs_attention.title: S4 caramel dimensions below spec, machine rejecting
needs_attention.summary: All caramel measured 14.95–15.44 mm, below required 17.3–17.9 mm spec; machine rejecting product, restarted from combing stage.
needs_attention.status: Operator making continuous adjustments to hit spec as of 04:40 (Luis Falcon). Cover 16 still rejecting pieces even when dimensions in spec at 09:49 (Mary Montilla), maintenance reviewing.

needs_attention.title: S2 ran out of flow wrap, order short 6–8 pallets
needs_attention.summary: Order required 270 pallets total, only had flow wrap for 28 of the 36 pallets needed at start of shift.
needs_attention.status: Packaged 28 pallets, came up short by 6 pallets per Daniel at 10:11. Customer/sales notified.

needs_attention.title: S4 soft caramel from 3rd shift operator error
needs_attention.summary: 3rd shift operator did not let caramel sit long enough before pushing to Conbar, resulting in soft caramel; trying to scrap but out of scrap barrels.
needs_attention.status: Waiting for L2 to send more scrap barrels as of 08:17. Brandon to follow up with team tonight (08:18).

needs_attention.title: S1 screw drive temperature sensor not reading correctly
needs_attention.summary: Temperature sensor on screw drive showing incorrect readings.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 08:21, no resolution posted in window.

needs_attention.title: S2 whole milk automatic filling pipe clogged to Mixing Tank B
needs_attention.summary: Pipe from Dairy Tank to Mixing Tank B clogged, unable to use automatic filling system.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance request submitted for pipe inspection when S2 Kitchen not running. Continuing manual add in meantime.

needs_attention.title: S3 pallets and floor above matrices have pistachio contamination
needs_attention.summary: Pallets stored above matrices have pistachio pieces, floor has small pistachio pieces in different areas requiring thorough cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 10:51, instructed to wash pallets and clean floor well. No completion confirmation in window.

needs_attention.title: FFS white line continues intermittent tracking issues
needs_attention.summary: After initial fix at 00:19, white line required additional stops and adjustments at 06:39 and 10:05; still back-and-forth at 10:53.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance going through rollers at 06:39, fold adjusted, running at 10:33. VFFS reports white line "still back and forth" at 10:53.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 2 ran out of white cream, many molds affected
needs_attention.summary: Operator on dep 2 had station off, hopper ran out of white cream, many molds went to cooling cabinet 3 with no filling; 2 barrels of scrap accumulated by 08:20 with more coming.
needs_attention.status: Itzel marking molds to track volume at 06:42, still checking how much went into cooling cabinet 3 with no white cream as of 08:20.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 3 circuit 2 temperature out of range
needs_attention.summary: Temperature reading posted at 06:47 shows circuit 2 on depositor 3 out of normal range.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 06:47, Nelson adjusted water pressure at 07:12, Itzel to post if temp gets better.

needs_attention.title: ML1 tempermeter missing probe holder piece
needs_attention.summary: Piece that sits on top of chocolate sample cup and holds temperature probe in place is missing from tempermeter.
needs_attention.status: Asked maintenance at 11:51 if they have replacement for this piece; no response in window.
